professions.summary: Anglers bring a Fish Bowl to camp at skill 20, which raises all stats by 8%, then a Fishing Rack and a Fishing Hut that open uncommon and rare catches. Luremaster gives a chance to catch an extra fish while a lure is active.
professions.title: How to fish in WoW Forever
professions.description: How to fish in WoW Forever: learn Fishing from a trainer, equip a pole and cast into water. Plus the lures, skill ranks, Find Fish and the Fish Bowl for camp.
tips: A Fish Bowl takes a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, which in Classic bites in the fresh water of the starting zones, and an Empty Vial from a vendor.
A Fishing Rack or Fishing Hut goes over your Fish Bowl and keeps its 8% to all stats.
Keep an eye on your lure. Luremaster's extra-catch chance needs it to be active.
Check your lowest tradeskill before using Dedicated Study if you want the point to go to Fishing.
The points below are still unconfirmed.

professions.steps_note: The trainers and suppliers come from Wowhead's Forever database, and the one in Valanaar from a beta player on the official forums; the rest is the client's own text.
steps: Ask a fishing trainer. There is one in each capital city, and one by the pond in Valanaar, the Skyborne city. Learning it also teaches Bait and Tackle, for placing Fishing objects at a camp.
Buy a Fishing Pole from the fishing supplier near the trainer and equip it from your bags. It takes both hands, and Fishing does nothing without it.
Face open water and cast Fishing from your spellbook. When the bobber splashes, right-click it to catch the fish.
Higher skill makes you more likely to land fish in higher-level zones. If your fish keep getting away, move to a lower-level zone or put a lure on your pole.

professions.name: Camping
professions.summary: A new Forever system. A cook builds a campfire, other players add objects from their professions, and anyone who sits by the fire for a minute gets their buffs for an hour. Each profession has three objects, the first at skill 20.
professions.title: Camping in WoW Forever: campfires and buffs
professions.description: How camping works in WoW Forever: the three campfires, what each profession brings at skill 20, 140 and 300, the buffs, their reagents and rested XP.
tips: A camp buff does not stack with the class buff it copies, such as the Fish Bowl with Blessing of Kings: you keep one or the other.

Only Leatherworking's Camp Tent, and the Tanning Rack and Sewing Machine that replace it, give rested experience. Thirty seconds by the tent raises yours to 5% of a level, once an hour, and does nothing if you already have more.
Most dishes a cook makes also give 5% more experience from kills (not from quests) while you are well fed. The Cooking page lists which ones.
The Faction Banner only buffs players of your own faction.
Camp objects can be traded, but placing one needs the profession skill it shows.
Add camp features often? Look at Field Guide and Reagent Economy. For longer benefits between stops, look at Permanence.
Check a feature's tier before counting on free reagents. Reagent Economy only names Tier 1.

professions.steps_note: Around level 5, the quest The Great Outdoors has you sit at a campfire, then sends you to a cooking trainer to learn the Basic Campfire; the trainer sells the Simple Wood and the Flint and Tinder. Each profession you know then gets a quest, handed in to its trainer, that teaches its first camp object. (Wowhead's Camping overview; the client has no quests.)
steps: A cook crafts a Basic Campfire Kit from one Simple Wood, with Flint and Tinder in the bags, and places it. It burns for 15 minutes, and no other campfire can stand within 100 yards.
From skill 20 in a profession, you place its object by the fire; the others come from other players. Your camp objects share a one-hour cooldown.
Anyone sitting or crafting by the fire for a minute gets the buffs of the objects around it. They last an hour, so you can leave once you have them.
